data.long_meaning: The name Aleix is of Catalan origin, and its meaning is 'defender' or 'little elf'. It is derived from the Old Germanic name Alais, which means 'precious, all-ruler'. In Catalonia, Aleix is a popular name for boys, and it is often given to children born in the autumn season. The name Aleix carries the meaning “Defender, little elf” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Aleix usually hope their child will grow to embody defender, little elf and live with faith, good character and purpose.
